treatments.label: Treatments
treatments.description: Browse broad care areas and prepare questions for a qualified provider.

items.title: Heart and vascular care
items.summary: Explore cardiovascular assessment, interventional care and surgical consultation pathways.
details: This listing is a starting point for a conversation with a qualified cardiovascular specialist.
A treating provider determines whether a treatment is appropriate after reviewing the individual case.

items.title: Cancer care
items.summary: Find information about multidisciplinary oncology consultation and treatment coordination.
details: Cancer care can involve multiple specialties. Request a clinical review from a qualified hospital team.
Published summaries do not replace diagnosis, staging or clinician guidance.

items.title: Orthopaedics and spine
items.summary: Explore consultation pathways for joint, bone and spine concerns.
details: A specialist determines appropriate investigations and treatment options based on a clinical examination and records.
Recovery timelines and outcomes differ between individuals.

items.title: Transplant programmes
items.summary: Understand the initial coordination steps for transplant programme enquiries.
details: Transplant care involves clinical, legal and hospital eligibility checks.
A coordinator cannot determine eligibility or replace advice from a transplant team.

items.title: Neurology and neurosurgery
items.summary: Explore care coordination for nervous-system assessment and specialist consultation.
highlights: Share records only through approved secure channels
details: A qualified clinician should review symptoms, examination findings and relevant records before discussing treatment options.

items.title: Women’s and children’s health
items.summary: Find coordination information for selected maternity, paediatric and fertility services.
highlights: Confidentiality should be discussed with providers
details: Service eligibility and availability depend on the provider, patient needs and applicable requirements.

procedures.label: Procedures
procedures.description: Review general procedure pathways. Only a clinician can advise whether a procedure is appropriate.

items.title: Joint replacement consultation
items.summary: Coordinate an orthopaedic consultation about joint symptoms and available options.
details: A clinician considers medical history, examination and imaging before recommending a treatment plan.

items.title: Cardiac surgery consultation
items.summary: Arrange a specialist discussion about cardiovascular surgical options.
details: This page describes coordination only and does not recommend a particular operation.

items.title: Robot-assisted surgery consultation
items.summary: Request information about provider assessment for selected robot-assisted procedures.
highlights: Compare benefits and alternatives with a surgeon
details: The treating surgeon determines whether a robot-assisted approach is clinically appropriate.

items.title: Radiation therapy consultation
items.summary: Coordinate a discussion with an oncology team about radiation treatment planning.
highlights: A cancer team reviews each case
Confirm cost and availability with the provider
details: The type, timing and risks of radiation treatment are determined by qualified oncology professionals.

items.title: Kidney transplant assessment
items.summary: Learn how to request an initial assessment from a transplant programme.
highlights: Only the transplant team determines next steps
details: No online enquiry can confirm transplant eligibility or guarantee a transplant.

treatment-costs.label: Treatment costs
treatment-costs.description: Costs depend on a reviewed case and provider quotation. No price on this demonstration site is a medical quote.

items.title: Cardiac care estimate
items.summary: Request a provider-issued estimate after specialist review.
highlights: Tests and length of stay can change totals
Ask what is included and excluded
details: A current estimate should come directly from the treating hospital after reviewing the proposed care plan.

items.title: Orthopaedic care estimate
items.summary: Compare written estimates for the proposed procedure and recovery plan.
details: Costs depend on the clinical plan, provider, room category and other individual requirements.

items.title: Oncology care estimate
items.summary: Ask a hospital team for an estimate based on the reviewed diagnosis and plan.
details: Only the treating provider can prepare a case-specific estimate. This listing is not a price offer.

items.title: Transplant care estimate
items.summary: Request a written estimate after programme and eligibility review.
details: Transplant estimates can change after clinical, donor, legal and hospital review.

services.label: Services
services.description: Practical coordination services surrounding a patient’s care and travel planning.

items.title: Patient care support
items.summary: A dedicated contact can help patients and families understand practical next steps.
highlights: Before, during and after the visit
details: Support may include communication and journey planning. It does not include diagnosis or treatment advice.

items.title: Appointment coordination
items.summary: Coordinate introductory appointments with relevant specialties and providers.
details: A coordinator can assist with logistics but cannot guarantee an appointment or admission.

items.title: Medical visa guidance
items.summary: Receive practical guidance about provider invitation requirements and travel documents.
details: This general coordination information is not immigration or legal advice. Applicants should check current official requirements.

items.title: Travel and local transfers
items.summary: Plan travel timing and local transfers around confirmed provider appointments.
highlights: Patients arrange their own travel decisions
details: Travel arrangements are subject to third-party availability and should be confirmed directly.

items.title: Accommodation assistance
items.summary: Compare accommodation options near a selected care provider.
details: Accommodation suggestions are not medical recommendations or guarantees of suitability.

items.title: Hospital assistance
items.summary: Get practical help navigating appointments and hospital administration.
highlights: Admission decisions remain with the hospital
details: A coordinator may help with wayfinding and communication but does not act as a clinical representative.

items.title: Interpreter support
items.summary: Ask about language support for conversations with providers.
details: Interpreter arrangements should be confirmed with the provider before appointments.

items.title: Secure records coordination
items.summary: Use an approved secure channel when a provider requests medical records.
highlights: Do not email sensitive files casually
details: The public enquiry form does not accept record uploads. Ask the provider for its approved secure process.

destinations.label: Destinations
destinations.description: Explore sample city pages for practical travel planning. Provider options and travel conditions must be checked independently.

items.title: New Delhi
items.summary: A destination overview for planning appointments, local transport and accommodation.
details: Confirm local travel, accessibility, accommodation and provider arrangements before booking.

items.title: Mumbai
items.summary: A sample destination page to support city-level medical travel discovery.
details: City information is general and should be supplemented with current local guidance.

items.title: Chennai
items.summary: A sample destination overview for coordinating a potential care visit.
details: This page does not endorse a provider or guarantee service availability.

items.title: Hyderabad
items.summary: A demonstration destination entry for medical travel planning.
details: Use current official travel and local transport information when planning a visit.

resources.label: Resources
resources.description: General planning resources. They are informational only and are not a substitute for professional advice.

items.title: First enquiry checklist
items.summary: Prepare questions and contact preferences before speaking with a coordinator.
highlights: Avoid sending sensitive documents through public forms
details: A short checklist can make an introductory coordination conversation more useful.

items.title: Medical travel planning guide
items.summary: Consider appointments, travel timing, accessibility and support-person needs.
details: This guide is general planning information and does not guarantee appointments, visas or outcomes.

items.title: Comparing provider estimates
items.summary: Questions to ask when comparing written estimates from hospitals.
highlights: Ask how long the estimate is valid
Request currency and exclusions in writing
details: A provider-issued estimate may change after examination, tests or changes to the treatment plan.

items.title: Questions for a specialist
items.summary: Organize questions for a consultation with a qualified clinician.
details: Only a clinician familiar with the case can answer individualized medical questions.

about.title: Practical coordination, centred on patient choice.
about.summary: CareRoute is a demonstration medical-travel coordination service model.

sections.heading: Our role
paragraphs: We help organize the practical steps around exploring care, including information gathering and travel coordination.
We do not diagnose conditions, provide treatment or determine clinical suitability.

sections.heading: Our information
paragraphs: Directory entries on this demo are fictional sample content. Replace them with reviewed and verified information before public launch.

patient-journey.title: A coordinated path from enquiry to follow-up.
patient-journey.summary: Understand the practical stages of an international care enquiry.

sections.heading: 1. Share a general enquiry
paragraphs: Tell us which specialty or type of coordination you are looking for. Do not use the general enquiry form to send medical records or passport information.

sections.heading: 2. Explore provider options
paragraphs: A coordinator can help identify relevant provider contacts. The treating provider reviews clinical information and determines eligibility.

sections.heading: 3. Plan travel after confirmation
paragraphs: Confirm appointments, requirements, travel documents and accommodation before making bookings.

sections.heading: 4. Coordinate practical support
paragraphs: Agree who to contact for arrival, appointments and follow-up. Medical decisions remain with qualified clinicians.

medical-visa.title: Medical travel documentation guide.
medical-visa.summary: General reminders for preparing questions about travel documents.

sections.heading: Check official requirements
paragraphs: Visa rules and document requirements can change. Consult the relevant government or consular source for current instructions.

sections.heading: Ask the provider about letters
paragraphs: If a hospital invitation or appointment letter is needed, confirm the request process directly with the provider.

sections.heading: Important limitation
paragraphs: This page is not immigration or legal advice. Visa decisions are made by the relevant authorities and cannot be guaranteed by a coordinator.

why-india.title: Compare care options with your priorities in mind.
why-india.summary: A neutral starting point for evaluating international care destinations.

sections.heading: Compare the complete journey
paragraphs: When comparing destinations, consider clinical suitability, provider credentials, communication, travel logistics and follow-up arrangements.

sections.heading: Ask for case-specific information
paragraphs: Availability, costs and care plans depend on the provider and individual case. Request written answers from the treating institution.

sections.heading: Make an informed decision
paragraphs: This site does not claim that one country or provider is appropriate for every patient. Discuss medical decisions with qualified clinicians.

faq.title: Questions about care coordination.
faq.summary: General information about the role and limits of a coordinator.

sections.heading: Does CareRoute provide medical treatment?
paragraphs: No. Medical care is provided by licensed healthcare professionals and institutions.

sections.heading: Can a treatment cost or outcome be guaranteed?
paragraphs: No. Ask the treating provider for a current written estimate and clinical guidance. Outcomes vary between individuals.

sections.heading: Can I send records through the enquiry form?
paragraphs: No. Use only a provider-approved secure channel if records are requested.

contact.title: Start with a general question.
contact.summary: Use the enquiry form for non-urgent care coordination questions.

sections.heading: Not an emergency service
paragraphs: For urgent or emergency symptoms, contact your local emergency services or a qualified healthcare professional immediately.

privacy.title: Privacy notice placeholder.
privacy.summary: This sample notice must be replaced with a reviewed policy before launch.

sections.heading: Demo environment
paragraphs: The local starter stores submitted enquiry contact details in SQLite. It is not configured for production health-data collection.
Publish a reviewed privacy notice describing purpose, lawful basis, retention, data access and contact procedures before collecting real enquiries.

terms.title: Terms placeholder.
terms.summary: Replace this demonstration text with reviewed terms before launch.

sections.heading: Informational use
paragraphs: This demo provides general coordination information only and is not medical, legal or immigration advice.
A qualified professional should advise on individual clinical questions.

medical-disclaimer.title: Clinical decisions belong to qualified providers.
medical-disclaimer.summary: CareRoute coordinates practical information and does not provide medical care.

sections.heading: No diagnosis or treatment
paragraphs: Website information is general and cannot be used to diagnose or treat a condition.
Always consult a qualified healthcare professional about diagnosis, treatment, risks and alternatives. For emergencies, contact local emergency services.

editorial-policy.title: How information should be reviewed.
editorial-policy.summary: A sample editorial framework for publishing accurate directory content.

sections.heading: Verification
paragraphs: Verify provider identity, credentials, services and contact details with primary sources before publication.
Mark estimates, sample data and update dates clearly. Correct outdated information promptly.

secure-records.title: Use a secure channel for sensitive documents.
secure-records.summary: The public enquiry form does not accept uploads or passport details.

sections.heading: Before sharing records
paragraphs: Ask the receiving hospital or provider for its approved secure transfer method.
Verify the recipient and share only the information needed for the stated purpose.
